
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/liuyangjava/p/19160481" title="发布于 2025-10-23 14:25">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Failed to start nginx.service: Unit nginx.service not found.</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>分享一篇nginx安装后，出现：Failed to start nginx.service: Unit nginx.service not found. 我们需要如何解决这个问题</p>
<p>在使用 Nginx 1.26.3 时遇到了 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">nginx.service</code>找不到的问题。这是因为通过源码编译安装 Nginx 后，systemd 没有对应的服务单元文件。别担心，我们可以手动创建一个</p>
<p><strong>1.创建服务文件</strong></p>
<p>使用vi编辑器在 systemd 的系统目录中创建服务文件。通常建议放在 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">/etc/systemd/system/</code>目录下</p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>sudo vi /etc/systemd/system/nginx.service</code></pre>
<p><strong>2.编写服务配置</strong></p>
<p>将以下内容复制到文件中。​<strong>请务必将路径 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">/usr/local/nginx/</code>全部替换为您实际的 Nginx 安装路径 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">/usr/local/nginx-1.26.3/</code></strong>​</p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>[Unit]
Description=The NGINX HTTP and reverse proxy server
After=network.target
[Service]
Type=forking
PIDFile=/usr/local/nginx-1.26.3/logs/nginx.pid
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/nginx-1.26.3/sbin/nginx -t
ExecStart=/usr/local/nginx-1.26.3/sbin/nginx
ExecReload=/usr/local/nginx-1.26.3/sbin/nginx -s reload
ExecStop=/usr/local/nginx-1.26.3/sbin/nginx -s stop
PrivateTmp=true
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target</code></pre>
<p><strong>关键提示</strong>​：请仔细核对并确保 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">PIDFile</code>、<code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">ExecStartPre</code>、<code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">ExecStart</code>、<code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">ExecReload</code>和 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">ExecStop</code>的路径都正确指向您的 Nginx 安装路径 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">/usr/local/nginx-1.26.3</code></p>
<p><code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">ExecStartPre</code>参数用于在启动前测试配置文件语法，能帮助提前发现配置错误</p>
<p><strong>3.重新加载systemd配置</strong></p>
<p>创建文件后，必须让 systemd 重新加载配置，以识别这个新服务</p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>sudo systemctl daemon-reload</code></pre>
<p><strong>4.启动并验证Nginx服务</strong></p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>sudo systemctl start nginx</code></pre>
<p>检查服务状态</p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>sudo systemctl status nginx</code></pre>
<p><img alt="Snipaste_2025-10-23_14-23-22" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1042681/202510/1042681-20251023142341079-609167490.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>5.设置开机自启动</strong></p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>sudo systemctl enable nginx</code></pre>
<p>检查确认开机自启是否已成功启用</p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>sudo systemctl is-enabled nginx</code></pre>
<p><img alt="Snipaste_2025-10-23_14-25-03" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1042681/202510/1042681-20251023142512004-2146030883.png" class="lazyload"></p>
</div>
